execution.raw_text:
{
  "up": "Select assay_chembl_id, target_type, tax_id, canonical_smiles, molecule_chembl_id, standard_type, pchembl_value
Join molecule_dictionary m ON activities.molregno = m.molregno
Join assays a ON activities.assay_id = a.assay_id
Join target_dictionary t ON a.tid = t.tid
Left Join compound_structures cs ON m.molregno = cs.molregno
Filter activities.activity_type = 'IC50'
Filter activities.standard_relation = '='
Filter activities.pchembl_value IS NOT NULL
Filter t.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL2996'
Filter t.target_type = 'SINGLE PROTEIN'
Filter t.tax_id = 9606
Sort by molecule_chembl_id, assay_chembl_id
Limit 1000"
}
